ycy config tunnel remove
Remove a locally remembered Tunnel connection
Usage:
  ycy config tunnel remove [connection-id] [flags]
Flags:
  -f, --force	Skip the removal confirmation
  -h, --help	help for remove
  --log-format	Diagnostic format: text or json
  --log-level	Log level: debug, info, warn, or error
  --quiet	Only emit error diagnostics (short form: -q)
  -v, --verbose	Enable debug diagnostics
